title: Design: Credit Hold banner and pill show on the work order Lines tab
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer A and customer B, neither on Credit Hold yet, so the payer can be put on Credit Hold during the case.
  • Have a new open work order for this test for customer B with customer A picked as its Bill To, so a work order bills a customer other than its own.
  • Put customer A on Credit Hold (Edit Customer, Credit Terms: Credit Hold).
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p3-14-after-banner.png, bt-p3-13-before-lines.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order.
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 pixels wide.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A red-outlined "Credit Hold" pill shows beside the status pill under the work order number.
  • A full-width pink banner with red text reads "Cannot invoice. The Bill To customer, [customer A's name], is on Credit Hold" (no full stop), with a red "Change Bill To" at its bottom right.

Step 2:

  • The banner text stays on one line and nothing overlaps.

Words in square brackets stand for the value they name, such as customer A's name exactly as it is saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12309 (Story 7, Invoicing to the Bill To)

  • S7-R6: “If the Bill To is on Credit Hold, the Credit Hold banner reads M2 with a "Change Bill To" button (work orders: page header; part sales: Finance tab).”
  • S7-R11: “The work order's Credit Hold and Over Limit badges describe the Bill To.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "3 When the Bill To is blocked", pictures "Banner" (This build), "Lines" (Production (v26.45.2.1)).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p3-14-after-banner.png
  • bt-p3-13-before-lines.png

The design's own words:

  • “Banner: "Cannot invoice. The Bill To customer, Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair, is on Credit Hold", with "Change Bill To".”
  • “The work order header shows a "Credit Hold" pill.”

Difference: the design places the banner under the tab bar on the Lines tab (BT-D10, question 10, held case DV-10).
